mechanism: Armodafinil may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of zidovudine and potentially increase CNS stimulation effects in HIV patients, while zidovudine's metabolic pathway via glucuronidation is not significantly affected.
action: Monitor for increased zidovudine toxicity (bone marrow suppression, peripheral neuropathy) and excessive CNS stimulation; consider dose adjustment of armodafinil if adverse effects emerge.
